description: This file contains a test class 'SampleStreamingTests' that demonstrates basic streaming patterns in Orleans. It includes multiple test scenarios such as consumer-then-producer, producer-then-consumer, and inline consumer setups, verifying message delivery, order, and counts in a streaming context.

classes.name: SampleStreamingTests
classes.description: A test suite demonstrating Orleans streaming producer-consumer communication patterns, including scenarios with delayed consumers, late producers, and inline consumers.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer
methods.description: Test scenario with consumer subscribing before producer starts, ensuring message delivery and no loss when producer begins after consumer.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Producer_Consumer
methods.description: Test with producer starting first and consumer subscribing later, validating late-join message reception.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Producer_InlineConsumer
methods.description: Test with inline consumer processing, evaluating latency and throughput.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Internal validation method that compares the number of messages produced and consumed, asserting correctness.
